verdict.rationale: Bolna documents a Tools tab of ready-to-use tools that can be enabled per agent, and tools are one of the provider types connected through Settings → Integrations. That implies some in-call tool use, but the evidence never shows custom functions or arbitrary external API calls made mid-conversation. The workflow 'API calls' feature covers multi-step outreach sequences, not in-call function calling. Missing for 10: documented custom function/API calling during a live call, how tool results are spoken back, any latency-masking or filler speech to avoid dead air, independent or hands-on corroboration.
